accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:transverse-minimax-rate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The asserted upper-bound transfer is confined to the calibrated cube, where the two-sided density bounds force f_P=2^{-d}; it makes no claim for generic bounded-density designs.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The matched rate is conditional on fixed calibrated κ and the class M_tr(γ;κ), not on the larger generic two-sided-bounded-density model.
